sql: SELECT pa.player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes pa WHERE substr(pa.date, 1, 4) = '2010' AND pa.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(pa2.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes pa2 WHERE substr(pa2.date, 1, 4) = '2010' AND pa2.overall_rating > (SELECT AVG(pa3.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes pa3 WHERE substr(pa3.date, 1, 4) = '2010'))
